description: A month view for picking a date, several dates, or a date range.
locale: The calendar is in Indonesian by default (weeks start on Monday). Change it with the locale prop if needed.

range.title: Date Range
range.description: mode="range" for a stay. numberOfMonths={2} shows two months.

disabledDays.title: Disabled Days
disabledDays.description: Disable past dates and closed days (example: every Monday).

dropdown.title: Month & Year Dropdowns
dropdown.description: captionLayout="dropdown" makes picking a birth date easier.

props.mode: How to pick: one date, several dates, or a range.
props.disabled: Dates that cannot be picked, e.g. { before: new Date() }.
props.captionLayout: Month title as text or dropdowns.
props.dayPicker: Calendar is built on react-day-picker. Every one of its props can be used — see daypicker.dev.
